meta.evidence_status: simulation (pencil model P1, synthetic handwriting and tremor; sensor models; nothing measured)
meta.sensors: LSM6DSV16X-class 6-axis IMU, gyroscope-compensated, pen rotation rho 0.5 (ASSUMPTION); page sensor 1 kHz / 2 ms
meta.case_group: Tremor tracker tuned by backpropagation: handwriting with 10 Hz, 0.3 mm tremor (pencil model P1)

cases.label: No correction (stage held at centre)
cases.note: Stage held at centre: the ink carries the hand's tremor.

cases.label: Physical limit (perfect disturbance knowledge)
cases.note: The stage is told the true disturbance, including the slow friction drift the tremor causes in this model.

cases.label: Tremor-band limit (perfect 3-15 Hz knowledge, not causal)
cases.note: The stage is told only the tremor-band (3-15 Hz) part of the disturbance: the best a tremor tracker can do.

cases.label: Previous best tremor tracker (AKF tuned on the grid's writing)
cases.note: Accelerometer Kalman filter with random-search settings tuned on smooth synthetic writing; it also moves sharper writers' tremor-free ink by about 150 um.

cases.label: Previous recommendation (robust AKF)
cases.note: The same filter with settings that barely touch tremor-free writing; it gives up most of the benefit.

cases.label: Accelerometer Kalman filter, robust settings re-optimised by backpropagation (this study)
cases.note: The same Kalman filter as the robust set, with the random search's own robust objective (tuning writing plus sharp glyph writers) minimised by gradient through the filter (its adjoint) instead of by random search.
